assumptions.statement: The user wants a compact markdown-first research datacube, not a literature warehouse.
assumptions.repair: demote or rewrite if later instructions ask for broader archival retention.

assumptions.statement: A salient ToE program should focus first on invariants and bridge claims rather than framework loyalty.
assumptions.repair: demote if a later phase requires framework-specific deepening.

assumptions.statement: The initial release should prefer conservative baseline constraints over bold canon claims.
assumptions.repair: revisit after several bridge experiments accumulate.

assumptions.statement: The next useful archive move is to sharpen live bridge families by exposing hidden assumption packages, not by expanding the family list.
assumptions.repair: demote if a later evidence review shows a missing family changes the pressure map more than assumption-audit work does.

assumptions.statement: The thermodynamic-gravity lane is currently best treated as a bounded derivational clue family until it shows gain beyond equilibrium reconstruction.
assumptions.repair: demote or revise if a later audit shows clear additional recovery power beyond the EFT baseline.

assumptions.statement: The next useful archive move is to gate entanglement-language claims by quantity, split, regime, observable consequence, and record carrier before adding more family prose.
assumptions.repair: demote if later work shows a concrete missing bridge family or empirical wedge matters more than admission discipline.

assumptions.statement: The next best family-C move is to test one concrete, regime-bounded holographic claim before adding any stronger reconstruction machinery or bibliography.
assumptions.repair: demote if later work shows the first concrete audit is too weak to discriminate and a different wedge changes archive state more efficiently.

assumptions.statement: After isolating the first real family-C surplus over thermodynamic language, the next useful move is to test whether any stronger reconstruction claim reduces boundary borrowing rather than merely widening the dictionary.
assumptions.repair: demote if later work shows the larger leverage lies instead in non-equilibrium observable mapping or cosmological boundary/law separation.

assumptions.statement: After installing a trace-and-witness rule for non-equilibrium family-B extensions, the next useful archive move is to test whether family C's current surplus survives beyond the narrow RT-style regime before broadening reconstruction prose.
assumptions.repair: demote if later work shows a family-B witness breakthrough or cosmological boundary/law split changes archive state more efficiently.

assumptions.statement: After installing family-specific record disciplines, the next useful move is to give the archive one shared witness-borrowing ladder so future B and C claims can be judged by whether they actually internalize more of the empirical loop.
assumptions.repair: demote if later work shows the ladder obscures rather than sharpens the decisive distinctions among bridge families.

assumptions.statement: After landing a first bounded covariant-carry result for family C, the next highest-leverage move is to test whether stronger reconstruction claims reduce boundary borrowing or honestly widen the regime beyond special holographic control without turning into vocabulary inflation.
assumptions.repair: demote if later work shows a genuine family-B witness breakthrough or cosmological boundary/law split changes archive state more efficiently than further family-C borrowing/regime audits.

assumptions.statement: After landing a first stronger-reconstruction no-climb audit for family C, the next highest-leverage move is to test whether any future lane can turn representational redundancy into candidate-native witness redundancy rather than only a sharper borrowed interface.
assumptions.repair: demote if later work shows the larger leverage lies instead in the cosmological boundary/local law split or in a genuinely new empirical wedge.

assumptions.statement: After landing a family-C witness-closure gate, the next highest-leverage move is to keep archive growth off the holography branch unless a claim can answer the gate natively; otherwise shift pressure toward the cosmological boundary/local-law split or a materially new empirical wedge.
assumptions.repair: demote if a later family-C result actually satisfies the gate in a compact, candidate-native way.

assumptions.statement: After installing a local-law / cosmological-boundary split, future archive moves should force candidates to earn those two kinds of explanatory credit separately rather than through blended narrative wins.
assumptions.repair: demote if a later synthesis shows a compact unified explanation that really discharges both burdens without hidden package-smuggling.

assumptions.statement: After installing a family-B minimum-gain gate, the next highest-leverage move is to apply the local-law / cosmological-boundary split to one concrete case—preferably the cosmological constant / vacuum-energy problem—rather than adding more abstract cosmology prose.
assumptions.repair: demote if a later bridge-family result creates a sharper discriminator with less archive growth than the concrete cosmology application.

assumptions.statement: After installing a first cosmological-constant debt split, the next highest-leverage move is to test one concrete mixed proposal class—preferably an integration-constant or unimodular-style move—rather than widening cosmology prose or bibliography.
assumptions.repair: demote if a different concrete vacuum-energy proposal class changes archive state more efficiently than the integration-constant lane.

assumptions.statement: After the first unimodular / integration-constant audit, the next highest-leverage cosmological-constant move is to test sequestering or related global-constraint packages rather than adding more prose about bookkeeping reclassification alone.
assumptions.repair: demote if a different concrete vacuum-energy proposal class turns out to reduce local threshold sensitivity more cleanly than the sequestering lane.

assumptions.statement: After the self-tuning / relaxation pass, the next highest-leverage cosmological-constant move is to test anthropic / landscape-selection classes directly and then force the remaining pressure onto explicit measure / population rules rather than broad landscape rhetoric.
assumptions.repair: demote if a later concrete local-law proposal class changes archive state more efficiently than tightening the cosmological-package side.

assumptions.statement: After the first concrete measure / population / typicality audit, the next highest-leverage cosmological-package move is to test one explicit causal-diamond or entropic-weighting package before broadening measure rhetoric again.
assumptions.repair: demote if a different concrete measure or self-location framework yields a sharper empirical wedge with less archive growth.
